The '''CD-34 blaster rifle''' was a type of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The CD-34 blaster rifle was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the Pursuer's Bounty Pack.
